title: Pace Advantage
summary: VER averaged 0.72s per lap faster than PER across this run.
why_it_matters: The gap is sustained over a multi-lap window, not just one outlier lap.

title: Tyre Degradation Signal
summary: PER's pace degradation steepens after lap 17 and peaks by lap 19.
why_it_matters: This suggests the tyre window closes earlier and pressure shifts toward a stop decision.

title: Strategy Moment
summary: The largest single-lap delta jump appears on lap 19.
why_it_matters: Lap 19 is the first lap to inspect for traffic, tyre drop-off, or pit strategy impact.

title: Builder Note
summary: From raw F1 telemetry to a pit-wall decision dashboard builders can run locally and later connect to Sisense.
why_it_matters: The value is the decision-ready analytics story, not isolated charts.
